name: idv-digilocker-v1
description: Forward-only identity verification V1 schema for FairSwap India
rollback_order: 1. Maintain FAIRSWAP_IDV_ENABLED=false (Default OFF immediately prevents user interaction across all clients)
2. Never unschedule revocation processing while outstanding provider revocations exist (ensure pending Setu revocations drain cleanly)
3. Never drop app_security or delete IDV audit data as a normal rollback (preserves immutable security trail)
4. If needed, drop forward functions and tables in reverse dependency order without touching existing baseline migrations (93 in staging, 77 in production).
